topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: Walking through the familiar hallways of the old school, the past seems to echo in every step, every creak of the floorboards. Seeing the same face from my childhood at the front of the classroom, explaining the same equations and stories, it’s as if time has looped back on itself. The world moves so quickly outside these walls, yet here, it feels like not a day has passed since I sat where my child now does. I watch them from afar, a small figure among a sea of young faces, and for a moment, I see myself. The air is thick, carrying whispers of memories, bittersweet and heavy.
